svg.title: From metadata.tex to the title page
svg.desc: How the lines in metadata.tex fill the title page. Pin 1: title = {Your thesis title} becomes the title, printed in capitals at the top of the page. Pin 2: author = {Your full name} becomes your name below the title. Pin 3: degree = doctoral becomes DOCTOR OF PHILOSOPHY under the fixed words Submitted in Partial Fulfillment of the Requirements for the Degree of (masters gives Master of Science, engineering-doctorate gives Doctor of Engineering). Pin 4: each committeemember line becomes one name in the list under Approved by, and the chair's name is followed by Chair. Pin 5: department becomes the department name near the bottom of the page, above Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute, Troy, New York. Pin 6: graduation-month and graduation-year become the bracketed date at the bottom, such as [May 2027]. The RPI seal, drawn as an empty dashed circle, is added by the class. A handwritten note says the fixed wording and layout come from the class file.
